title: State
description: C-lane proposal to A for packages/contracts. Caller-owned decision context threaded across director.decide() calls. Extends the four fields the v3 plan lists (current camera, last cut time, mode, hold_until) with last_utterance_id, which lets the correction override remain a pure function.

Mode.description: AUTO: policy may TAKE. ASSIST: policy proposes; producer confirms. HOLD: policy blocks all AI TAKEs; safety failover still applies.

current_camera.description: Camera_id currently live. Null before the first TAKE.

last_cut_time.description: Producer clock seconds of the last successful TAKE. Used to enforce MIN_SHOT_S (2.5s).

hold_until.description: If non-null and now < hold_until, TAKEs are blocked as if mode were HOLD. Used for the '5s manual hold after keypress' pattern.

last_utterance_id.description: utterance_id of the cue that drove the last TAKE. When the incoming cue shares this id, the min-shot gate is bypassed for one re-cut.
